# Acuere Consultancy

> Valuation, transaction structuring and CFO advisory firm in Mumbai, India, established March 2022. Led by CA Rahul Nathani, Fellow Chartered Accountant (FCA) and IBBI Registered Valuer (Securities or Financial Assets), Reg. No. IBBI/RV/02/2022/14763. 250+ valuation opinions delivered.

## Valuation services
- Valuation reports for listed companies: SEBI ICDR preferential issues (Regulations 163(3), 165, 166A), schemes of arrangement, share exchange ratios
- Independent valuation of AIF portfolios under the SEBI AIF Regulations and IPEV Guidelines (Category I, II and III)
- Companies Act, Income Tax (Rule 11UA), FEMA and IBC/CIRP valuations
- Ind AS fair value: Ind AS 113, 103 (PPA), 102 (ESOP), 109 (financial instruments)
- Instruments: equity, CCPS, CCDs, preference shares, options, ESOPs, market-linked debentures

## Other services
- Transaction structuring: investor entry and exit, CCPS/CCD design, ESOP architecture
- Virtual CFO services
- Internal audit and forensic review
- Investment banking support

## Who we work with
Listed companies, AIF investment managers, PE and VC funds, startups, Insolvency Professionals, Chartered Accountants and Company Secretaries, across India.
